item.pol02_1: District councils or the municipal council meet regularly and are open to the public
item.pol02_2: Public hearings or open town meetings are held at least once a year
item.pol02_3: The community takes part in setting investment priorities (participatory budgeting, consultations on the plan or budget)
item.pol02_4: Active community organisations (development associations, committees) are taken into account in local decisions
item.pol02_5: There are participation spaces for young people and women (for example, a cantonal youth committee, women's networks)
item.pol03_1: The municipality publishes its budget, plans and execution reports in a way citizens can access
item.pol03_2: Municipal council minutes and major decisions are public and easy to consult
item.pol03_3: Local authorities present an annual accountability report to the community
item.pol03_4: There is a well-known channel for queries, complaints or reports, and the municipality answers within reasonable time
item.pol03_5: Oversight bodies (comptroller, internal audit) have recently flagged serious breaches that have not been corrected
item.pol04_1: A current local development plan exists (cantonal or district development plan)
item.pol04_2: A current land-use plan or similar territorial planning instrument exists
item.pol04_3: The development plan is monitored with known targets and indicators
item.pol04_4: There is a disaster-risk management plan and a working emergency committee
item.pol04_5: Building permits are granted in hazard or protected areas
item.pol05_1: Basic municipal services (waste collection, street lighting, road maintenance) are delivered regularly
item.pol05_2: Municipal procedures (permits, licences) are resolved within reasonable time
item.pol05_3: The municipality has technical staff for roads, environment and planning
item.pol05_4: The municipality takes part in partnerships or agreements with institutions, universities or organisations for local projects
item.pol06_1: People have access to justice services (court, public defence, prosecutor) in the area or within reasonable distance
item.pol06_2: Local alternative dispute-resolution mechanisms exist (community mediation, conciliation)
item.pol06_3: Local policies and services are applied without discrimination by gender, origin, disability or social status
item.pol06_4: There are frequent reports of abuse of authority or discrimination by public officials
